description: This file defines utility functions and classes for tensor shape expansion and inference in the ATen library, part of PyTorch. It includes functions for size inference, shape expansion, and shape compatibility checks, with a focus on tensor broadcasting and shape manipulation.

classes.name: InferExpandGeometryResult
classes.description: A template class to hold the result of shape expansion inference, including sizes and strides.

methods.name: infer_size
methods.description: Infers the broadcasted size of two input size arrays.

methods.name: infer_size_symint
methods.description: Infers the broadcasted size with symbolic integers.

methods.name: infer_size_dimvector
methods.description: Infers the broadcasted size as a DimVector.

methods.name: infer_size_symdimvector
methods.description: Infers the broadcasted size as a SymDimVector.

methods.name: inferExpandGeometry
methods.description: Infers the expanded geometry (sizes and strides) for tensors.

methods.name: infer_dense_strides
methods.description: Calculates dense strides for a given tensor size.

methods.name: are_expandable
methods.description: Checks if two shapes are broadcastable.

methods.name: check_defined
methods.description: Checks if tensors are defined, throws error if any are undefined.

methods.name: expand_inplace
methods.description: Returns a MaybeOwned tensor, expanding if necessary, for in-place expansion.

methods.name: expand_outplace
methods.description: Expands tensors to a common shape without modifying originals.

methods.name: expand_size
methods.description: Expands a tensor to a specified size.

methods.name: sum_to
methods.description: Reduces a tensor to a specified shape via summation.

methods.name: is_expandable_to
methods.description: Checks if a shape can be expanded to a desired shape.
